title: Spanish Courgette Fritters
description: A crispy Spanish-style fritter recipe using courgette, great as a side dish or snack.
instructions: 1. Grate the courgette into a bowl.
2. In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, and salt.
3. Add the dry ingredients to the courgette and mix well.
4. Beat the egg in a separate bowl.
5. Add the beaten egg to the courgette mixture and mix until a thick batter forms.
6. Heat the vegetable oil in a deep frying pan to 180°C (350°F).
7. Using a spoon, drop small amounts of the batter into the hot oil.
8. Cook for 2-3 minutes on each side or until golden brown.
9. Drain the fritters on paper towels and serve hot.
